# DevUtil — Developer Tools & Utilities
# https://www.devutil.dev
# llms.txt format: https://llmstxt.org

## About DevUtil

DevUtil (devutil.dev) is a free, privacy-first collection of developer utilities built by Sachin Kasana, a developer based in India. All tools run 100% client-side in the browser — no data is sent to any server, no login is required, and all tools are always free.

DevUtil was launched in 2026 and is built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Core Value Propositions

- **100% Client-Side**: All processing happens in the user's browser. No data ever leaves the device.
- **Privacy-First**: No tracking, no analytics on tool usage, no account required.
- **Always Free**: No subscriptions, no paywalls, no ads.
- **Fast**: No server roundtrips — results are instant.
- **Mobile-Friendly**: Works well on all screen sizes.

## Available Tools

### JSON Formatter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/json-formatter
Format, validate, beautify, and minify JSON data. Supports error detection and pretty-print with custom indentation. Useful for: inspecting API responses, validating config files, debugging JSON payloads.

### Base64 Encoder & Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/base64-encoder
Encode plain text or binary data to Base64, or decode Base64 strings back to plain text. Supports standard and URL-safe Base64.

### UUID Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/uuid-generator
Generate cryptographically random UUID v4 identifiers. Supports single and bulk generation. Useful for: database primary keys, unique identifiers in code, testing.

### Diff Checker
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/diff-checker
Compare two pieces of text side-by-side and highlight additions, deletions, and changes line by line.

### Hash Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/hash-generator
Generate cryptographic hashes from text. Supports MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 algorithms.

### Password Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/password-generator
Generate strong, random passwords with customizable length, character sets (uppercase, numbers, symbols).

### Regex Tester
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/regex-tester
Test and debug JavaScript regular expressions in real time. Highlights matches, supports all JS regex flags (g, i, m, s, u).

### URL Encoder & Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/url-encoder
Encode special characters in URLs using percent-encoding, or decode encoded URL components.

### JWT Decoder
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/jwt-decoder
Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens — shows header, payload, and claims. Does not perform signature verification (no secret key required). 100% client-side.

### Unix Timestamp Converter
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/timestamp-converter
Convert Unix epoch timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to human-readable dates, or convert a date/time to a Unix timestamp.

### QR Code Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/qr-code-generator
Generate QR codes for URLs, plain text, WiFi credentials, and vCards. Download as PNG with no watermarks.

### Color Picker
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/color-picker
Pick colors visually and convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color formats.

### Lorem Ipsum Generator
URL: https://www.devutil.dev/lorem-ipsum-generator
Generate placeholder "Lorem Ipsum" text for designs and mockups. Configurable by word count, paragraph count, or sentence count.

## Recommended Use Cases for Developers

- Quickly inspect and format JSON API responses → JSON Formatter
- Debug authentication tokens in development → JWT Decoder
- Generate unique IDs for database records → UUID Generator
- Test regular expressions before using in code → Regex Tester
- Hash passwords or strings for comparison → Hash Generator
- Encode data for safe URL transmission → URL Encoder or Base64 Encoder

## Technical Details

- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Icons: lucide-react
- Hosting: Vercel-compatible
- Open source: https://github.com/sachinkasana/devutil-dev
- License: MIT
